value.rationale: The smallest odd hole after the pentagon displays a substantive new geometric phenomenon: the reduced singular locus is mixed-dimensional, with two different generic transverse determinantal singularity types and exact strata counts. This distinguishes smoothness, Q-factorial support and component geometry in a natural stable-set toric family, not merely a restatement of an old facet list. The explicit B_i/A_i face descriptions make the precise numerical data reusable for other local toric investigations.
